title: GitHub - alsoleg89/doubt: Turn contested questions into interactive, source-grounded evidence maps.
excerpt: Turn contested questions into interactive, source-grounded evidence maps. - alsoleg89/doubt
content_html:
AI research tools usually end with prose. Prose is good at sounding settled: support and contradiction blur together, missing evidence becomes a footnote, and a citation may merely mention the topic.

Doubt produces a different artifact:

  • one falsifiable question and one provisional position;
  • atomic claims, sourced observations, and explicit unknowns;
  • typed supports, contradicts, qualifies, and missing edges;
  • a dated URL or local path, retrieval date, plus a section, page, timestamp, or line locator for every evidence node;
  • one self-contained HTML file that stays inspectable without an account, server, or CDN.

Try it in the browser

Open the local-only Doubt playground →

Paste or drop a .doubt.json file to run the same evidence-contract module used by the CLI, inspect exact findings, preview the interactive map, and download portable JSON or HTML. Copy a share link to let another reader inspect the same map without an upload: the payload lives in the URL fragment, which browsers do not send in the HTTP request. Validation, SHA-256 receipts, rendering, and downloads run in the tab; map content is never submitted over the network.

Explore the evidence maps

  • Are Agent Skills actually portable? — one conservative core works across Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and Gemini CLI, but discovery paths, invocation, consent, permissions, metadata, and distribution still require per-host testing.
  • Agent Skills vs MCP — when a capability should be reusable procedure, a live protocol boundary, or both. Built from the Agent Skills specification, GitHub's implementation, the discovery RFC, and the current MCP architecture and security guidance.

All maps are committed as editable .doubt.json, validated with the same evidence contract, and rendered as self-contained HTML.

Try the real map

npx doubt-ai demo --out doubt-demo.html

The public package is doubt-ai; the CLI has zero runtime dependencies and requires Node.js 18 or newer.

The command renders a current architecture decision from official Agent Skills, GitHub, and MCP sources:

Should an AI capability be an Agent Skill, an MCP server, or both?

Open doubt-demo.html to read the linear brief, switch to the reasoning graph, and inspect exact source regions. The canonical editable input is plain JSON; the generated self-contained HTML has no runtime dependencies.

Give the workflow to your agent

Install directly from GitHub with GitHub CLI 2.90 or later:

gh skill install alsoleg89/doubt doubt

Or use the open Agent Skills installer for Codex, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and other compatible clients:

npx skills add alsoleg89/doubt --skill doubt

Or install the portable skill into every supported local agent:

npx doubt-ai init --agent all

Then ask:

Use $doubt to map whether we should replace our current auth provider.
Preserve contrary evidence and show the exact source region behind every edge.

The skill works with Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and clients that support the open Agent Skills layout. It uses the research and browsing capabilities the agent already has; Doubt does not proxy prompts or require a model key. The checked-in remote-install skill and GitHub project skill are byte-verified against the canonical install payload on every CI run.

The installed skill carries the same deterministic evidence contract as the package in scripts/validate.mjs. An agent can validate and obtain the real receipt with Node.js 18+ even when its sandbox cannot reach npm. The skill explicitly forbids substituting a file hash, node count, or JSON parse check for a successful Doubt receipt.

Compatible remote clients can also discover a digest-pinned archive through the Agent Skills well-known index.

Render your own

npx doubt-ai validate decision.doubt.json
npx doubt-ai map decision.doubt.json --out decision.html
VALID ccfb781d43c6
  ✓ 3 claims · 5 evidence · 5 sources
  ↯ 2 contradictions · 1 explicit unknowns
  map /path/to/decision.html

Validation fails closed when:

  • evidence has no source;
  • a source has no valid publication/retrieval date, safe location, bounded locator, or substantive excerpt;
  • evidence or sources are decorative and unused;
  • an edge is duplicated, cyclic, points to a missing node, or lacks a reasoning note;
  • any reasoning node lacks a directed path to the position;
  • the position has no incoming support, contradiction, qualification, or gap;
  • a map invents unsupported confidence percentages.

Each valid map receives a SHA-256 receipt over the canonicalized reasoning record plus explicit hashes of every recorded excerpt and its retrievedAt value. The receipt proves what the map recorded and when it says the source was retrieved; it does not prove that a mutable URL still serves those same bytes.

Gate evidence maps in CI

Add one reusable Action to validate every *.doubt.json file in a repository:

name: Evidence contract
on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  doubt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: alsoleg89/doubt@v0.8.0

The Action fails the check with file-level annotations and writes receipts, claim/evidence counts, and every violated invariant to the job summary. It uses the checked-in validator directly—no package install, model key, account, or network call.

Known negative fixtures can remain committed without weakening the gate:

      - uses: alsoleg89/doubt@v0.8.0
        with:
          exclude: benchmarks/expected-failures

Adversarial benchmark

npm run benchmark

The published evidence-contract report mutates the dogfood map to introduce unsourced evidence, malformed dates, missing or unbounded locators, thin, oversized, and repeated-filler excerpts, dangling and duplicate edges, disconnected subgraphs, cycles, invented confidence, decorative sources, an unsupported position, and embedded markup. Every case names the invariant that must fire.

This benchmark measures structural traceability and safe rendering. It does not pretend to measure whether a source is true or whether an AI extracted it faithfully.

Agent Skills portability benchmark

The public portability map identifies a missing edge: documentation shows a shared Agent Skills core, but not identical behavior across clients. The five-client benchmark kit fixes one synthetic fixture, one unchanged skill, and direct, implicit, and negative prompts for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.

npm run benchmark:portability

Results require exact client versions, relevant configuration, sanitized raw output, generated artifacts, and receipts. A contributor can submit one client; failures and blocked runs are valid evidence. The first submitted result is GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.77: direct pass, implicit fail, and negative pass. The failure is preserved with its artifact and raw transcript; even though v0.6 now accepts its absolute local paths, the agent never ran or reported the required validation, so the historical run is not relabeled as a pass.

The Codex CLI result preserves a more useful before/after. With the old skill, direct and implicit activation both failed because npx doubt-ai could not reach npm from a network-disabled sandbox; both final answers then falsely claimed validation. With the exact validator bundled in the skill, the same client, model, fixture, prompts, and sandbox produced independently verified receipts: direct pass, implicit pass, negative pass. See the historical failure and fixed-skill rerun. One client may not claim cross-client behavioral equivalence.

Run a remaining client →: Claude Code, Codex result, GitHub Copilot result, Cursor, or Gemini CLI.

Reader benchmark — recruiting

The structural benchmark does not answer the product question: does an interactive evidence map actually help a reader more than cited prose?

Take the five-topic map-vs-memo study →

The protocol was committed before data collection. Each reader sees five technical decisions, alternating between a Doubt map and a hand-edited cited memo built from the same frozen sources. The study measures position, contradiction, qualification, unknown, and exact source-region recall.

It runs entirely in the browser and downloads one anonymous result JSON. It does not request a name or email and never submits data over the network. The first analysis is locked until ten complete reader sessions; neutral and negative results will be published.

Build or validate the study locally:

npm run benchmark:reader
npm run benchmark:reader:check

The evidence contract

{
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "observed-result",
      "type": "evidence",
      "label": "Observed result",
      "text": "The focused acceptance suite passed.",
      "sourceId": "test-run"
    }
  ],
  "edges": [
    {
      "from": "observed-result",
      "to": "current-position",
      "relation": "supports",
      "note": "The suite exercises the promised narrow behavior."
    }
  ],
  "sources": [
    {
      "id": "test-run",
      "title": "Acceptance test output",
      "url": "./test-output.txt",
      "publisher": "Local test runner",
      "date": "2026-07-30",
      "retrievedAt": "2026-07-30T12:00:00Z",
      "locator": "Summary line 42",
      "excerpt": "The focused suite completed with 18 passing checks and zero failures."
    }
  ]
}

Read the complete map schema and evidence ladder.

Why it is not another research chatbot

Typical output What gets lost Doubt
Cited prose answer Disagreement is flattened into a narrative Keeps contrary and qualifying edges visible
Knowledge graph Related concepts can look like evidence Requires a plain-language entailment note
Argument-map platform The reasoning lives in an account or database Canonical JSON plus portable HTML
Diagram generator A beautiful graph can still be unsourced Refuses evidence without a bounded source region
Confidence score Precision can be invented Represents the specific unknown instead

The renderer is deterministic. The AI may propose the map; it cannot make an invalid evidence record pass the validator.

Commands

Command Purpose
doubt map <file.json> --out <file.html> Validate and render an interactive map
doubt validate <file.json> Check the evidence contract without rendering
doubt verify <file.json> --out <verified.json> Explicitly retrieve each source, match its excerpt, and write an attested map only if all sources pass
doubt demo --out <file.html> Render the included dogfood map
doubt init --agent all Install the map-building skill
doubt doctor --agent all Detect missing or locally modified skill copies

Existing skills are never overwritten unless --force is passed.

Privacy and trust

The renderer reads only the JSON file you pass and writes the requested HTML. The installer copies static skill files. No telemetry, background service, remote runtime, model call, or hidden network request is used.

doubt verify is the only network-capable command, and it runs only when you invoke it explicitly. It sends an HTTP GET to each recorded http(s) source, blocks localhost and private addresses by default, checks every redirect, matches the normalized excerpt, and records the retrieved-byte SHA-256. It never uploads the map or excerpt to Doubt. Local file sources stay local. If one source is unreachable or mismatched, verification fails closed and no output map or receipt is written. Page, section, and timestamp locators remain marked not-machine-checked; line ranges are checked against the selected lines.

The first live dogfood run rejected Doubt's own flagship example: all five recorded excerpts were paraphrases rather than text present in the cited pages. The example was rewritten with verbatim excerpts and now commits a successful attestation for every source. The portability map does the same for all eight of its sources.

A valid map proves structural traceability, not truth. A verified map adds evidence that its recorded excerpt appeared in the retrieved bytes at one time; it still does not prove that a source is true or correctly interpreted. That is why source regions, edge notes, contradictions, and unknowns remain visible for review.

See SECURITY.md for the threat model.

Development

git clone https://github.com/alsoleg89/doubt.git
cd doubt
npm test
npm run demo

Doubt uses Node.js built-ins only. Tests cover schema invariants, content-addressed receipts, self-contained rendering, the CLI, and skill installation.

Contributions are welcome—especially real contested questions, adversarial map fixtures, source-locator adapters, and accessibility improvements. Start with CONTRIBUTING.md.

If an answer matters, make its evidence navigable.

It sends an HTTP GET to each recorded http(s) source, blocks localhost and private addresses by default, checks every redirect, matches the normalized excerpt, and records the retrieved-byte SHA-256. Page, section, and timestamp locators remain marked not-machine-checked; line ranges are checked against the selected lines.

content_html_zh:
人工智能研究工具通常以散文结尾。 散文擅长听起来很确定：支持和矛盾模糊在一起，缺失的证据成为脚注，引文可能只是提到主题。

怀疑会产生不同的产物：

  • 一个可证伪的问题和一个临时立场；
  • 原子声明、来源观察和明确的未知数；
  • 类型支持、矛盾、限定和缺失边缘；
  • 带日期的 URL 或本地路径、检索日期，以及每个证据节点的部分、页面、时间戳或行定位符；
  • 一个独立的 HTML 文件，无需帐户、服务器或 CDN 即可检查。

在浏览器中尝试一下

开放本地独有的 Doubt 游乐场 →

粘贴或删除 .doubt.json 文件以运行 CLI 使用的相同证据合同模块、检查确切的结果、预览交互式地图以及下载可移植的 JSON 或 HTML。 复制共享链接，让其他读者无需上传即可检查同一张地图：有效负载位于 URL 片段中，浏览器不会在 HTTP 请求中发送该片段。 验证、SHA-256 收据、渲染和下载在选项卡中运行；地图内容永远不会通过网络提交。

探索证据图

  • 特工技能真的可以移植吗？ — 一个保守的核心适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、Cursor 和 Gemini CLI，但发现路径、调用、同意、权限、元数据和分发仍然需要每个主机测试。
  • 代理技能与 MCP — 当一项功能应该是可重用过程、实时协议边界或两者兼而有之时。 根据代理技能规范、GitHub 的实现、发现 RFC 以及当前的 MCP 架构和安全指南构建。

所有地图均以可编辑的 .doubt.json 形式提交，使用相同的证据合约进行验证，并呈现为独立的 HTML。

尝试一下真实的地图

npx doubt-ai demo --out doubt-demo.html

公共包是疑点-ai； CLI 具有零运行时依赖性，并且需要 Node.js 18 或更高版本。

该命令根据官方 Agent Skills、GitHub 和 MCP 源呈现当前的架构决策：

AI 功能应该是代理技能、MCP 服务器还是两者兼而有之？

打开 Question-demo.html 阅读线性简介，切换到推理图，并检查确切的源区域。 规范的可编辑输入是纯 JSON；生成的独立 HTML 没有运行时依赖性。

将工作流程交给您的代理

使用 GitHub CLI 2.90 或更高版本直接从 GitHub 安装：

gh skill install alsoleg89/doubt doubt

或者使用适用于 Codex、Claude Code、Copilot、Cursor、Gemini CLI 和其他兼容客户端的开放 Agent Skills 安装程序：

npx skills add alsoleg89/doubt --skill doubt

或者将便携式技能安装到每个受支持的本地代理中：

npx doubt-ai init --agent all

然后问：

Use $doubt to map whether we should replace our current auth provider.
Preserve contrary evidence and show the exact source region behind every edge.

该技能适用于 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Gemini CLI 以及支持开放代理技能布局的客户端。 它使用代理已有的研究和浏览功能；怀疑不会代理提示或需要模型密钥。 签入的远程安装技能和 GitHub 项目技能在每次 CI 运行时都会根据规范安装负载进行字节验证。

安装的技能与 script/validate.mjs 中的包具有相同的确定性证据合约。 即使其沙箱无法到达 npm，代理也可以使用 Node.js 18+ 验证并获取真实收据。 该技能明确禁止用文件哈希、节点计数或 JSON 解析检查来替换成功的怀疑收据。

兼容的远程客户端还可以通过代理技能众所周知的索引发现摘要固定的存档。

渲染你自己的

npx doubt-ai validate decision.doubt.json
npx doubt-ai map decision.doubt.json --out decision.html
VALID ccfb781d43c6
  ✓ 3 claims · 5 evidence · 5 sources
  ↯ 2 contradictions · 1 explicit unknowns
  map /path/to/decision.html

验证失败，在以下情况下关闭：

  • 证据没有来源；
  • 来源没有有效的发布/检索日期、安全位置、有界定位器或实质性摘录；
  • 证据或来源只是装饰性的且未被使用；
  • 边重复、循环、指向缺失节点或缺少推理注释；
  • 任何推理节点都缺乏到达该位置的有向路径；
  • 该职位没有任何支持、矛盾、资格或差距；
  • 地图发明了不受支持的置信百分比。

每个有效的映射都会收到一个基于规范化推理记录的 SHA-256 收据以及每个记录摘录及其检索值的显式哈希值。 收据证明地图记录的内容以及何时检索来源；它并不能证明可变 URL 仍然提供相同的字节。

CI 中的门证据图

添加一个可重用的 Action 来验证存储库中的每个 *.doubt.json 文件：

name: Evidence contract
on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  doubt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: alsoleg89/doubt@v0.8.0

该操作无法通过文件级注释进行检查，并将收据、索赔/证据计数以及每个违反的不变量写入作业摘要。 它直接使用签入的验证器，无需安装包、模型密钥、帐户或网络调用。

已知的负面装置可以在不削弱大门的情况下保持承诺：

      - uses: alsoleg89/doubt@v0.8.0
        with:
          exclude: benchmarks/expected-failures

对抗性基准

npm run benchmark

已发布的证据合同报告改变了dogfood地图，引入了无来源的证据、格式错误的日期、缺失或无界的定位器、薄的、超大的和重复填充的摘录、悬垂和重复的边缘、断开的子图、循环、虚构的置信度、装饰性来源、不受支持的位置和嵌入的标记。 每个案例都命名了必须触发的不变量。

该基准衡量结构可追溯性和安全渲染。 它不会假装衡量来源是否真实或人工智能是否忠实地提取它。

代理技能可移植性基准

公共可移植性地图发现了一个缺失的边缘：文档显示了共享的代理技能核心，但客户端之间的行为并不相同。 五客户端基准测试套件修复了一项合成装置、一项未更改的技能，以及 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Cursor 和 Gemini CLI 的直接、隐式和负面提示。

npm run benchmark:portability

结果需要准确的客户端版本、相关配置、经过净化的原始输出、生成的工件和收据。 一名贡献者可以提交一名客户；失败和受阻就是有效的证据。 第一个提交的结果是 GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.77：直接通过、隐式失败和否定通过。 失败与其工件和原始记录一起保存；尽管 v0.6 现在接受其绝对本地路径，但代理从未运行或报告所需的验证，因此历史运行不会重新标记为通过。

Codex CLI 结果保留了更有用的之前/之后。 使用旧技能，直接激活和隐式激活都失败，因为 npx Question-ai 无法从网络禁用的沙箱访问 npm；两个最终答案都错误地声称验证。 通过技能中捆绑的确切验证器，相同的客户端、模型、夹具、提示和沙箱生成独立验证的收据：直接传递、隐式传递、否定传递。 查看历史故障和固定技能重运行。 一位客户不得声称跨客户的行为等同。

运行剩余的客户端 →：Claude Code、Codex 结果、GitHub Copilot 结果、Cursor 或 Gemini CLI。

读者基准——招募

结构基准并没有回答产品问题：交互式证据图实际上比引用的散文更能帮助读者吗？

进行五个主题的地图与备忘录研究 →

该协议是在数据收集之前提交的。 每个读者都会看到五个技术决策，在怀疑图和根据相同的冻结来源构建的手工编辑的引用备忘录之间交替出现。 该研究测量位置、矛盾、限定、未知和确切的源区域回忆。

它完全在浏览器中运行并下载一份匿名结果 JSON。 它不会请求姓名或电子邮件，也不会通过网络提交数据。 第一次分析被锁定，直到十个完整的读者会话；中性和负面的结果将被公布。

在本地构建或验证研究：

npm run benchmark:reader
npm run benchmark:reader:check

为什么它不是另一个研究聊天机器人

典型输出 失去了什么 Doubt
引用的散文答案 分歧被扁平化为叙述 保持相反和限定边缘可见
知识图谱 相关概念可能看起来像证据 需要简单语言的蕴涵注释
论证图平台 推理存在于帐户或数据库中 规范的 JSON 加上可移植的 HTML
图表生成器 漂亮的图表仍然可以是无源的 在没有有限源区域的情况下拒绝证据
置信度得分 精度是可以发明的 代表具体的未知数

渲染器是确定性的。 AI可以提出地图；它不能使无效的证据记录通过验证器。

命令

命令 目的
怀疑图 <file.json> --out <file.html> 验证并渲染交互式地图
怀疑验证 <file.json> 检查证据合同无需渲染
怀疑验证 <file.json> --out <verified.json> 显式检索每个源，匹配其摘录，并仅在所有源都通过时才编写经过验证的映射
怀疑演示 --out <file.html> 渲染包含的dogfood地图
怀疑 init --agent all 安装地图构建技能
怀疑医生——代理所有人 检测丢失或本地修改的技能副本

除非通过 --force ，否则现有技能永远不会被覆盖。

隐私和信任

渲染器仅读取您传递的 JSON 文件并写入请求的 HTML。 安装程序复制静态技能文件。 不使用遥测、后台服务、远程运行时、模型调用或隐藏网络请求。

怀疑验证是唯一支持网络的命令，并且仅在您显式调用它时才运行。 它将 HTTP GET 发送到每个记录的 http(s) 源，默认情况下阻止本地主机和私有地址，检查每个重定向，匹配规范化摘录，并记录检索到的字节 SHA-256。 它从不将地图或摘录上传到 Doubt。 本地文件源保留在本地。 如果一个源无法访问或不匹配，验证将失败并关闭，并且不会写入输出映射或收据。 页面、部分和时间戳定位器仍标记为未机器检查；根据所选行检查行范围。

第一次现场测试拒绝了 Doubt 自己的旗舰示例：所有五个记录的摘录都是释义，而不是引用页面中存在的文本。 该示例已用逐字摘录重写，现在为每个来源提交了成功的证明。 可移植性映射对其所有八个源执行相同的操作。

有效的地图证明了结构的可追溯性，而不是事实。 经过验证的地图添加了证据，表明其记录的摘录一次出现在检索到的字节中；它仍然不能证明来源是真实的或正确解释的。 这就是为什么源区域、边缘注释、矛盾和未知因素仍然可见以供审查。
